country.name: México
country.languagePolicy: Spanish is the default interface language. Indigenous-language access must be planned with the relevant community and authoritative language resources; automatic translation is not treated as reviewed educational localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Mexican reviewer, a current authoritative source, and review of the applicable federal and state jurisdiction.

governanceModel.summary: The national education system combines federal authority, state education authorities, autonomous institutions and institution- or program-specific recognition. A federal record must not be silently treated as complete state coverage.
governanceModel.stateAuthorityRule: Record the responsible state education authority and state-issued recognition when it applies.
governanceModel.institutionRule: Autonomous universities and other legally empowered institutions may operate under distinct authority; verify the particular institution and program.

authorities.name: Sistema de Información y Gestión Educativa
authorities.role: national education information and school consultation system

authorities.name: Dirección General de Acreditación, Incorporación y Revalidación
authorities.role: federal recognition, incorporation, equivalence and revalidation functions within SEP scope

authorities.name: Dirección General de Profesiones
authorities.role: professional title and credential registry functions

authorities.name: Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno
authorities.role: federal personal-data authority within its statutory competence after the 2025 reforms

curriculum.title: Plan de Estudio 2025 para educación preescolar, primaria y secundaria
curriculum.stateImplementationRule: Confirm calendars, implementation guidance, indigenous and community adaptations, and state-issued instructions with the responsible state authority.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: External materials may supplement but never replace, waive or silently reinterpret controlling requirements.

schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: SIGED reports school information supplied through national education statistics and authorities. BRASA must preserve source-cycle and update dates and must not infer current recognition solely from an older listing.
requiredRecordFields: official or institutional URL when available

upperSecondary.authority: SEP and applicable federal or state authority
upperSecondary.recognitionRule: Private programs require verification of the applicable official recognition; a provider name alone is insufficient.

higherEducation.authorityNotice: RVOE attaches to a specific program, campus, modality and issuing authority. It is not a blanket approval of every program offered by an institution.
higherEducation.stateRecognitionRule: Search and record state-issued RVOE separately where the responsible state authority issued it.
higherEducation.autonomousInstitutionRule: Verify the legal authority and official program information of autonomous institutions directly.

qualityAssurance.legalRecognition: RVOE or other applicable statutory authority

voluntaryAccreditation.name: COPAES-recognized accrediting organizations
voluntaryAccreditation.notice: Program accreditation is a quality signal and must not be substituted for legal recognition.

voluntaryAccreditation.name: CIEES
voluntaryAccreditation.notice: Evaluation or accreditation status must be verified for the specific program and effective period.

privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Public and private institutions can be governed by different personal-data regimes and authorities. State and institutional safeguarding protocols must be reviewed before real learner participation.

completionCriteria: A qualified Mexican education reviewer is named.
Federal and state authority boundaries are reviewed and approved.
Every school record preserves CCT, source cycle, jurisdiction, provenance and review date.
Every private or non-autonomous program displays program-, campus-, modality- and authority-specific recognition evidence where applicable.
Curriculum mappings are reviewed by phase, field and relevant state implementation context.
Indigenous-language and community adaptations are reviewed with competent local participation.
Privacy, child protection, accessibility, incident and consent procedures are approved by the participating institution and applicable authority.
No accreditation, recognition, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
